title: fix(plugin-dashboard): metric tiles give the title its own line, keyed off the tile's width (objectui#12623)
body:
Fixes #12623
Clause-②: no

## What changed

After objectui#12528 / objectui#12573 the dataset-bound metric tile drew its title and measure label side by side, and the label did not shrink. At 1024 px, on objectui 33fbc861d with HotCRM 63db83e, Sales Performance showed 35–37 px of titles that are 87–128 px long, and Executive Overview 37–61 px. Readings are in `measurements.json` on the evidence branch.

One module, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/metricTile.ts`, now holds the tile layout rule. Every metric tile reads it: `DatasetWidget` (dataset-bound), `MetricWidget` (plain; also `ObjectMetricWidget` and every `object-metric` page block), and `MetricCard`. Before this there were three separate headers; the card's assumption that they shared one did not hold.

- **Target 1, the title:** it owns the first line at 13 px / 500 (`text-[13px] font-medium`), up to two lines with an ellipsis on the second (`line-clamp-2`). On the dataset-bound tile the measure label moves to an 11 px muted line under the value (`text-[11px] text-muted-foreground`). It is dropped below a 160 px tile (`hidden @[160px]:block`) and appended to the title's tooltip on its own line, so it is still readable at every width.
- **Target 2, the value:** it never wraps (`whitespace-nowrap`) and is 20 px below a 160 px tile, 24 px from there up (`text-xl @[160px]:text-2xl`).
- **Width rules:** they are container queries on the tile (`@container`), never the viewport. A dashboard grid, a page block and the Studio's folded canvas each size the tile differently.
- **Target 3, Sales Home:** HotCRM Sales Home's KPI blocks are `object-metric` nodes, which render `MetricWidget`. They follow the rule with no code of their own; the pin file renders that node through `SchemaRenderer` to check it.

### Pins updated, and why

- `DashboardRenderer.metricTileDensity-12528` and `DashboardSurfaces.metricTileTwoLines-12573` asserted the measure label inside the heading row and nothing after the value. They now assert the title alone in the heading row, then the value, then the label. They also asserted a tooltip of the description alone; it is now the description, a newline, and the measure label.
- `DashboardSurfaces.datasetSubCaption` L2 asserted the same tooltip; it is updated the same way.

### Deviations

- A `DatasetWidget` rendered directly with no surface heading keeps its old markup (its byte pins are unchanged). No dashboard surface draws that path, and there the label is the only text naming the value.
- `MetricWidget`'s `bare` variant is unchanged: it has no title line, and its label already sits under the value.
- The plain tiles' title also carries its text as a tooltip, so a title clamped at two lines can be read in full.
- The 160 px threshold is measured on the tile's own content box, which is 134 px inside a roughly 150 px card at 1024 px.

## Acceptance

1. **Tests:** `metricTileLayout-12623.test.tsx` pins the contract, because jsdom has no layout. It pins the title's clamp classes, the label's container-query hiding and its presence in the tooltip, and the value's `whitespace-nowrap` and step class. Browser readings, from the dashboard's own tile forced to an exact width:
   - 150 px: every title is complete (for example 'Total Pipeline', 'Open Opportunities' and 'Closed Won (QTD)', none clipped), the measure label is absent, and the value is 20 px on one line.
   - 240 px: every title is complete, the label shows at 11 px, and the value is 24 px on one line.
2. **Screenshots:** listed below.
3. **Package tests:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard test` is green, with the counts in Test evidence below.

### Browser readings (light and dark identical)

- At 1024 px, Sales Performance: 'Total Pipeline', 'Closed Won (QTD)', 'Open Opportunities' (two lines) and 'Avg Deal Size' are complete in 134 px boxes, values are 20 px on one line, and there is no label. The second-row tiles are 195 px boxes, so their 11 px label shows.
- At 1024 px, Executive Overview: 'Total Revenue (YTD)' (two lines), 'Active Accounts', 'Total Contacts' and 'Open Leads' are complete, values are 20 px, and there is no label.
- At 1280 px, both dashboards: 198 px boxes, titles complete on one line, values 24 px, labels shown at 11 px.
- Sales Home at 1024 px: the four KPI blocks have complete titles and 24 px values on one line.

## Test evidence (head 0b89223)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard test`: exit 0, Test Files 181 passed (181), Tests 1800 passed and 6 skipped (1806).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` and `build`: exit 0. eslint on the touched files: 0 errors, and no warning on a changed line.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Ablation, once per pin family. Each mutation was checked on disk and restored from HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty after each restore.
  - Title `line-clamp-2` → `truncate`: 5 red.
  - Value nowrap and step → `text-2xl`: 4 red.
  - Label `hidden` → `block`: 1 red.
  - `@container` removed: 5 red.
  - Tooltip without the label: 5 red across the 12528, 12573, datasetSubCaption and 12623 files.
  - Label line under the value removed: 5 red across the 12528 and 12573 files.

## Acceptance notes

- On positioned dashboards the KPI tiles still stand about 176 px tall, from the `layout.h` × 5rem row floor that objectui#12573 triaged. It is visible in the screenshots and is not part of this card.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01NF7uo9pabBTvsZorpskLaE`.
